changelog:
- Initial release of sol-take: generates a daily hot take on AI, 150–200 words, in Sol's direct, wry voice.
- Rotates through 18 distinct AI topics (e.g., hype cycle, agents, regulation, code quality).
- Uses MiniMax to create a sharp opinion piece, posted daily at 9am UK time.
- Automatically generates and commits a Jekyll post to GitHub.
- Requires MiniMax API key and site repo setup.
summary: Daily hot AI opinion — 150-200 word take on one AI topic, rotating through 18 topics, in Sol's direct wry voice.
